Conducts studies and testing on new and modified designs. Develops design information for use in drawings and specifications.</p></li><li><p>Provides engineering design, maintenance support and training for new product and equipment. Assesses new and existing equipment to optimize design efficiency, safety, quality, and cost effectiveness.</p></li><li><p>Designs and conducts experiments, collects data, and interprets results; conducts analysis and writes analysis and test reports. Capable of drawing conclusions and reconciling differences between predicted values and actual results.</p></li><li><p>Plans, coordinates, and executes, with guidance, a variety of engineering activities including documentation, reporting, publishing, and making technical or other presentations.</p></li><li><p>Designs new equipment and machinery. May assist in building, installing, debugging, and testing new equipment to ensure production capabilities.</p></li><li><p>Determines maintenance schedules, procedures, and safety standards for current and new equipment to ensure equipment is operated, maintained, and serviced properly.</p></li><li><p>Determines technical objectives and develops innovative, practical solutions to advance technical engineering problems. Provides technical support to failure investigations and bid responses.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><b><span>What You Bring:</span></b></p><p></p><ul><li><p>Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering; advance degree a plus.</p></li><li><p>Minimum 2-10 years work experience dealing with manufacture and design of engineered products.</p></li><li><p>Experience with rotating equipment and machine designs (motors, pumps, generators and propulsors).</p></li><li><p>GD&amp;T, CAD systems, CAE systems, FEA methods.</p></li><li><p>Ability to create models and drawings, present design reviews, and perform trade studies and design reviews. Capable of coordinating multiple project responsibilities. Must be a team player and have knowledge of MS Office Suite.</p></li><li><p>Ability to perform analysis and studies with strong attention to details in a fast-paced environment.</p></li><li><p>Due to DoD requirements, candidates must be US citizens.</p></li><li><p>Must be able to obtain and maintain DOD security clearance.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><b>Who we are:</b></p><p><a href=\"https://www.curtisswright.com/company/sustainability/core-values/default.aspx\" target=\"_blank\">Our Values</a></p><p><a href=\"https://curtisswright.com/company/sustainability/default.aspx\" target=\"_blank\">Environmental, Social and Governance</a></p><p></p><p>EMD a business unit of Curtiss-Wright in Cheswick, PA designs, manufactures, tests, and provides after-market support for the most advanced, proven and reliable critical function pumps, motors, generators, seals, control rod drive mechanisms and power conditioning electronics available anywhere in the world today.
